name: Slovakia
summary: Possessing any amount is a crime. Since Aug 2024 the Criminal Code sets 'negligible amounts' (e.g. 2 g cannabis): up to 1 yr for cannabis, 2 yrs for other drugs; more carries 6 months–6 yrs.
callingForHelp: No Good Samaritan law. Paramedics are bound by medical confidentiality, but police may attend, and possessing even a negligible amount is a crime.
drugChecking: No drug checking service is known to operate legally in Slovakia.

lsd.note: Up to 3 blotters ('negligible amount'): up to 2 yrs; up to 15 blotters: 6 months–3 yrs; more: 1–6 yrs.

mushrooms.note: Negligible amount is 10 g dried (≤100 mg psilocybin/psilocin): up to 2 yrs. Growing ≤40 fruiting bodies: up to 1 yr. More: harsher.

dmt.note: DMT is listed. Up to 1 g ('negligible'): up to 2 yrs; more: 6 months–6 yrs. Ayahuasca contains DMT.

mescaline.note: Mescaline is listed; possession is a crime (up to 2 yrs for ≤1 g). Cacti are not named on the list.

dox.note: DOB, DOC, DOET etc. are listed; possession of any amount is a crime (up to 2 yrs for a negligible amount).

nbomes.note: 25I-NBOMe and related NBOMes are listed; possession of any amount is a crime.

2c-x.note: 2C-B and other 2C-x are listed; possession of any amount is a crime (up to 2 yrs for ≤1 g).

2c-t-x.note: 2C-T-2 and 2C-T-7 are listed; possession of any amount is a crime.

5-meo-xxt.note: 5-MeO-MiPT and 5-MeO-DALT are listed (crime). 5-MeO-DMT was not found on the 2026 list, so its status is less clear.

cannabis.note: Up to 2 g (≤200 mg THC): up to 1 yr; ≤10 g: 6 months–3 yrs; more: 1–6 yrs. Growing ≤2 plants: up to 6 months. CBD hemp legal.

ketamine.note: Listed medicine (anaesthetic). Possession without a prescription is a crime (up to 2 yrs for ≤1 g).

mxe.note: Methoxetamine is listed; possession of any amount is a crime.

dxm.note: Explicitly excluded from the drug lists. Some cough products are sold OTC in pharmacies; Stopex tablets are prescription-only since 2015.

nitrous.note: Not a listed drug and no specific consumer ban found. EU rules may stop sales of large canisters to the public from Feb 2027.

amphetamines.note: Negligible amount 0.2 g (amphetamine or methamphetamine): up to 2 yrs; more: harsher. ADHD medicines are prescription-only.

mdma.note: Negligible amount is 3 pills or 0.8 g: up to 2 yrs; up to 15 pills: 6 months–3 yrs; more: 1–6 yrs.

cocaine.note: Negligible amount is 0.3 g: up to 2 yrs; up to 1.5 g: 6 months–3 yrs; more: 1–6 yrs.

caffeine.note: Legal and not a controlled substance.

alcohol.note: Legal from 18; selling or serving alcohol to under-18s is prohibited.

ghb/gbl.note: GHB and GBL are both listed, so possession is a crime. Sodium oxybate is prescription-only.

opioids.note: Heroin: negligible amount 0.5 g (up to 2 yrs). Morphine, oxycodone, fentanyl are prescription-only; without one, possession is a crime.

tramadol.note: Prescription-only medicine; not on the Slovak controlled-drug list, so possession without a prescription is not a drug crime.

benzodiazepines.note: Prescription-only; diazepam and most others are listed psychotropics, so possession without a prescription can be a crime.

maois.note: Pharmaceutical MAOIs are prescription-only. Harmala alkaloids/Syrian rue are not listed; DMT in ayahuasca is.
